records.canonicalQuestion: How should I feed a Cursor chat to ChatGPT for harvest without treating ChatGPT as source of truth?
alternateQuestions: What verdict should ChatGPT use for improvement-only extraction?
records.shortAnswer: Feed chat-improvement-extract-chatgpt-v1.md with Cursor chat. Output improvements (token/arch/speed/intelligence). Code claims are CROSS_CHECK_CANDIDATE until Cursor verifies in Git.
records.detailedAnswer: ChatGPT improvement-extract lane for Cursor chats

futureAgentInstructions.whenThisAppears: Operator wants ChatGPT to digest a Cursor session
doNot: Claim HARVEST_COMPLETE or INDEX_HIT in ChatGPT
Promote code seeds without XC cross-check in Cursor
proveBeforeClaiming: XC rows UNVERIFIED until grep/MCP in owning repo

records.canonicalQuestion: Where should full harvest protocol markdown live vs GitHub?
alternateQuestions: What does Supabase store for cross-agent ledger ingest?
records.shortAnswer: Full harvest protocol prose lives on L: 03-protocols/harvest and Z operator copy. Cross-Agent Git keeps pointer stubs and harvest JSON. Supabase stores truncated ledger slices and pointer projection_body only.
records.detailedAnswer: Harvest protocol storage — L full, Git pointers, Supabase metadata only

futureAgentInstructions.whenThisAppears: Harvest protocol edits, Git bloat, or ledger Supabase ingest
doNot: Commit full protocol markdown to Cross-Agent GitHub
Store protocol prose or full ledger JSON in Supabase projection_body
proveBeforeClaiming: docs/runbooks/*.md are pointer stubs linking to L:

records.canonicalQuestion: What gets written to Supabase on cross-agent ledger ingest?
alternateQuestions: How to avoid bloating Supabase with harvest protocol prose?
records.shortAnswer: cross-agent-ledger:ingest --apply uses supabase-pointer-sanitize: truncated open_actions/blockers/saved_work with authorityPath; projection_body is pointer manifest not full ledger JSON.
records.detailedAnswer: Supabase cross-agent ledger — pointer-only projection on ingest

futureAgentInstructions.whenThisAppears: cross-agent-ledger ingest or Supabase projection drift
doNot: Store full ACTIVE_WORK prose or protocol markdown in projection_body
